description: This file contains unit tests for the CallLogHandler component in an Android application. It tests various scenarios such as permission checks, JSON input validation, filtering, pagination, default parameters, null handling, limit and offset clamping, and error handling related to call log search functionality.

classes.name: CallLogHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of CallLogHandler in various scenarios related to call log searching.

classes.name: FakeCallLogDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of CallLogDataSource used within tests to simulate call log data source behavior.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly rejects call log access when permission is not granted.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests that invalid JSON input results in an error response.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_returnsCallLogs
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly returns call log data given valid input.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withFilters
methods.description: Tests filtering of call logs based on provided criteria.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withPagination
methods.description: Tests pagination (limit and offset) handling when fetching call logs.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withDefaultParams
methods.description: Tests default parameter behavior when no input JSON is provided.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withNullFields
methods.description: Verifies handling of call logs with null values for optional fields.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_clampsLimitAndOffsetBeforeSearch
methods.description: Ensures limit and offset are constrained within valid bounds before executing the search.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_mapsSearchFailuresToUnavailable
methods.description: Verifies that internal exceptions are mapped to a 'CALL_LOG_UNAVAILABLE' error response.
